verdict.line: You lose if you let him taunt-chain you into tower aggro, you win every extended trade he takes outside Shadow Dash range.

brief.thesis: Shen's entire kit is built around poke-and-shield skirmishing, but Mordekaiser's Darkness Rise aura and Q (Obliterate) damage scale past anything Shen can sustain through once W (Indestructible) shields are stacked. At 50.4% over 1715 games this is a dead-even stat line, but the OP.GG read is correct: you out-damage him in any fight that isn't fought under his turret, so the matchup is decided by who controls when the fight actually starts.

theirWindow.when: Right after he dashes E (Shadow Dash) at you
theirWindow.what: Shadow Dash is on a long 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown and only taunts if he hits you directly, so if he whiffs it or you dodge, he has no follow-up disengage besides W (Feint) — this is when you commit Q (Obliterate) and E (Death's Grasp) back-to-back.

yourWindow.when: His W (Feint) is down and you have Darkness Rise active
yourWindow.what: Without Feint absorbing your burst, Shen has no shield between his Q (Vorpal Blade) life-tap and your damage — walk up, land Q (Obliterate), and hold E (Death's Grasp) to pull him back in if he tries to walk off.

powerCurve.note: Trades are poke-only, Vorpal Blade life-tap matters most
E (Death's Grasp) online lets you punish his dash-ins
Darkness Rise uptime outpaces his Ki Strike healing
Riftmaker/Liandry's burn outheals his Feint shield value
Stand United global save can undo a won fight

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Run at 50.5% pick rate and 50.5% win rate — the extra mana and sustain let you throw Q (Obliterate) into every Vorpal Blade poke exchange without running dry before level 6.

boots.why: 53% pick rate; Shen's Vorpal Blade and taunt-into-auto combo are physical-damage-based, so the flat reduction blunts his main poke tool better than magic resist boots.

core.why: The slow from Q (Obliterate) and E (Death's Grasp) keeps Shen inside your damage aura instead of kiting out to reset Ki Strike.
Omnivamp sustains you through his sustained Vorpal Blade poke, and the empowered-damage passive rewards the long fights this matchup wants.
Run in 18.1% of games at 59.2% win rate — burn damage ticks through Feint's shield window instead of being absorbed outright.

his team is stacking attack speed or crit and you need the grievous wounds + armor

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through every Q (Obliterate) poke and Shadow Dash exchange, then converts to healing exactly when Shen tries to out-sustain you with Vorpal Blade.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts a 46.3% win rate but lets you reset after level-6 all-ins and still make side-lane splits, which matters since Shen himself can Stand United away from a losing fight — Flash+Ignite (74.3% pick, 50.1% win) is the higher-floor choice if you want guaranteed kill pressure on his low-sustain starts instead.

playing.title: Punish Shadow Dash whiffs immediately
playing.detail: E (Shadow Dash) is on a 16-second cooldown at rank 1 and only taunts on direct hit — if he dashes and misses, he has committed hard with no disengage besides Feint, so burn Q (Obliterate) and E (Death's Grasp) on the spot.

playing.title: Hold Death's Grasp for his dash, not his auto
playing.detail: E (Death's Grasp) pulls everything in its area, so firing it as he dashes in cancels his positioning advantage instead of wasting the pull on a poke he was already going to land.

playing.title: Track Darkness Rise stacks before committing
playing.detail: You need 3 landed attacks or spells on him to trigger the aura — bait a Vorpal Blade poke first so your stacks are already up when the real trade starts.

playing.title: Don't fight through Feint
playing.detail: W (Feint) absorbs incoming damage for a few seconds on a 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown — if he pops it on cooldown cycle, back off the all-in for two seconds rather than dumping your full combo into a shield.

playing.title: Save Indestructible for the counter-trade
playing.detail: W (Indestructible) stores damage dealt and taken — use it on offense during your all-in window, then consume it to heal right after he lands his own poke, not reactively before he's hit you.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Stand United
playing.detail: R (Stand United) has a 200/180/160s cooldown and can save an ally or let Shen reposition globally — don't assume a won skirmish at mid-lane or bot is safe from his ultimate once he hits 6.

playing.title: Extend fights, don't burst them
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read holds: you deal more damage the longer the fight runs, so walk Shen away from minions and towers before committing instead of trying to win in two ability rotations.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample-size figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1) across 1715 Mordekaiser-vs-Shen matches; the tactical reasoning — cooldown windows, stack timing, and trade sequencing — is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Shen is an easy opponent to lane against, with you always dealing more damage unless you are under enemy turret. Maintain your [P] active while prolonging the fight.
